objective: Provide operational intelligence regarding common transportation methods, vehicle usage and movement patterns observed in narcotics trafficking investigations to support risk assessment and investigation planning.

transport_patterns.common_usage: Most frequently used for interstate distribution due to extensive highway connectivity and operational flexibility.
Used for transporting concealed narcotics over long distances through passenger or parcel services.
Primarily associated with international trafficking, courier networks and passenger baggage concealment.
Increasingly used for concealed shipments through commercial logistics services.

route_characteristics.description: Movement of narcotic substances across state boundaries requiring coordination between enforcement agencies.
Distribution occurring within a single state through local transportation networks.

investigation_indicators: Repeated movement along known trafficking corridors.
Use of hired or borrowed vehicles.
Frequent courier bookings under different identities.
investigation_guidelines: Examine travel history and route consistency.
Coordinate with neighboring state agencies for interstate cases.
Inspect hidden compartments and modified vehicle structures.
references: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) World Drug Report
